//: The npm test wall-time budget of docs/STORE-SAAS.md §J.1 (rev 5, CRIT2-9) as data: seconds on the owner's PC per group, read by scripts/qa/test-budget.ts. The sum of a release's groups must not exceed its ceiling and must equal its declared total; a group's scripts are the §J.1 / §J.6 rows its track owns. A release with `extends` adds its groups to that release's. `measuredSec` is the group's time in the last timed run (`npm run test:budget`) that re-cut the table; the static check refuses a share below it. Maintainer-owned (§K.3): a part changes its share through a CCR. Re-cut at P0 (review G7, CCR r1.0-c0b-3 items 2 and 3) from the timed run of 2026-10-28 on the owner's PC (heavy mutex held, 1.7 GB free): existing 88.5 s, core 63.0 s, then 46.1 s once test:prepublish's ar fixtures and lock child processes moved to test:slow; the R1 ceiling is raised from 180 s to 240 s and the track shares cut to fit (the declared 175 s could not hold the 150 s the two maintainer groups measure). P0b (2026-10-28, the track planners' shared needs): test:conversions moved from existing (90 to 85 s) to operations (15 to 20 s, CCR P5-7), test:shell joined platform (CCR P2-2), and test:tracking / test:leads left landing for test:db while test:checklist joined it (CCR P3-10); the total stays 235 s of 240 s.

groups.note: measured by this harness at C0b; above 30 s the maintainer moves the slowest of these suites' sweeps to test:slow. Measured then on the shared PC: the group 82.5 s, the npm test chain 111 s, the timed total 121 s of 180 s; the group stays over its 30 s until the table is re-cut at P0 (item 2). Re-cut at P0 (review G7): 88.5 s measured (theme:check 31.2, test:generator 17.2, test:render 13.1, test:offers 11.6, test:conversions 5.1, test:runtime 4.1, test:orders 2.7, test:money 2.5, pretest 1.1), share 90 s. Its suites are P6's and read-only files; a further cut moves a sweep to test:slow through the owning track. P0b (CCR P5-7): test:conversions (P5) moved to the operations group, so the share is 85 s and measuredSec 83.4 s (the G7 run's 88.5 s minus the 5.1 s test:conversions took in that run; not a new timing)
